passes.notes: Answer A sorts the steps by urgency: 'start here', 'before your first order' and 'when you're ready'. It explains that sorting and defers integrations and cycle counts, though all nine steps stay in the modal and approval rules still come before the first order. Answer B groups the steps by topic and sensibly moves the catalog import before par levels, but it gives no sense of what's urgent and doesn't cut anything. Both answers drop the feature list and only say vaguely that steps can be done later, without saying where or when they come back.

Both rewrites keep all nine steps in the wizard. A only regroups and reorders them. B at least puts them in priority tiers, from 'Start here' to 'Set up when you're ready', and explains that this shows the admin what is urgent. B still doesn't truly defer anything. It also doesn't say where deferred steps come back, and its explanation says the feature list has 'fifteen nouns' when it has about 12.
